name: Gas Station Agent
description: Finds nearby gas stations, petrol stations and fuel stations. Searches around current location or a specified city, address, street, or landmark and returns station names and addresses.

skills.name: Find Nearby Gas and Fuel Stations
skills.description: Finds the closest gas, petrol and fuel stations near current position or a specified location. Supports an optional search radius and returns station names and addresses.
examples: where is the nearest gas station?
find the closest gas station near me
find a petrol station near Big Ben
